pages.title: Gene Sequencer
pages.text: Reads a genome letter by letter - and, run backwards, writes one.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Reads and writes genomes. Feed it samples from a $(item)Gene Sampler$().

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 2 fluid inputs, 2 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Apoptosis Trigger, Cryptochrome Magnetoreceptor, Folded Protein Crystal, Genome Sample, Minimal Synthetic Cell, Recombinant DNA, Silicon Life Spore, Xenogenome Sample.
Use on any creature to take a genome sample. Creatures from other dimensions give xenogenome samples.$(br2)Made in a crafting grid.
